message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look table of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that create a 3‑day weekend when combined with Saturday + Sunday).  
All dates are in the *local time zone* of the province where the holiday is observed; the table reflects the national statutory holidays that apply to most provinces.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) | Jan 1 – 3 | Observed Monday when holiday falls on Sunday |
| **Family Day** (most provinces) | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | Feb 18 – 20 | Third Monday in February (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB, MB, NS, PEI, NL) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | Apr 7 – 9 | Friday + weekend |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | May 20 – 22 | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) | Jul 1 – 3 | Observed Monday when holiday falls on weekend |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | Sep 2 – 4 | First Monday in September |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | Oct 7 – 9 | Second Monday in October |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Nov 13 (Monday) | Nov 11 – 13 | Observed Monday when holiday falls on weekend |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | Dec 23 – 25 | First Monday in December |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | — | No long weekend (falls on Tuesday) |

### Quick Summary
- **Total long weekends:** 9 (excluding Boxing Day)
- **Typical pattern:** Holiday on Monday → Saturday + Sunday + Monday; Holiday on Friday → Friday + weekend; Holiday on Saturday → Saturday + weekend + Monday (observed Monday).

### Additional Provincial Variations
Some provinces have extra statutory holidays that can create long weekends, e.g.:

| Province | Extra Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed | Long‑Weekend Span |
|----------|---------------|-------------|----------|-------------------|
| **Quebec** | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Sunday) | Jun 25 (Monday) | Jun 24 – 26 |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Sunday) | Mar 20 (Wednesday) | — (no long weekend) |
| **Ontario** | *None beyond Family Day* | — | — | — |

These provincial holidays are optional for your app depending on whether you want to include all possible long‑weekend opportunities.

---

#### How to Use This List
1. **Calendar Integration** – Add each span (e.g., Jan 1 – 3) as a “long‑weekend” event in your holiday‑planning app.
2. **Travel Planning** – Highlight these periods for users looking to book short trips.
3. **Regional Customization** – If you want to support province‑specific holidays, add the extra rows above.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, iCal, etc.) or if you need the same information for another year!
